caption: The drawing depicts a single stoneware jug standing upright against a plain, light-colored background. The jug has an elongated, rounded body that tapers towards a narrow neck and a small mouth at the top, which features a looped handle attached from the neck to the shoulder of the vessel. The jug is rendered in shades of brown and gray, giving it a speckled, earthy appearance. Near the upper shoulder of the jug, there is a simple, dark blue drawing of a bird, and above the bird, some text is inscribed in a curved manner, reading “B. M. McCure & Co / TROY.” The overall composition is centered, with the jug occupying most of the space. The artist's signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
